package unplaced

import (
	"net/http"

	"example.test/auth"
	"example.test/httperr"
)

type Handlers struct{}

func (h Handlers) GetPlacedReport(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if err := auth.Require(r.Context()); err != nil {
		httperr.Write(w, r, err)
		return
	}
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, []int{1})
}

// Added beside the placed report, under a path no family names.
func (h Handlers) GetBrandNew(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, []int{2})
}

func (h Handlers) ListContacts(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	httperr.WriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, []string{"a contact"})
}
